title: feat(spec): a plugin-driver datasource can declare its row cap, external.rowCap, up to 10,000
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ83WAcW3kdc2RHYZ2aeB5krB)_
Part of #29762 — the spec slice. The engine floor reading the key, and the guide on whole-set views, are the card's second PR, opened after this one merges.

Clause-②: yes (widening) — one optional, bounded key joins the external datasource settings; the default keeps today's 1,000
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: follow-up #29762 — this card's second PR teaches the key in content/docs/data-modeling/virtual-objects.mdx and odata-datasources.mdx

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:外部数据源设置新增可选键 `external.rowCap`(1–10,000,不写即 1,000),只在 spec 层声明与校验。
- 为什么改:客户的虚拟对象甘特图约 5,000 行,固定 1,000 行上限直接 422;Warren 裁定 (a)+(c),平台最大值 10,000。
- 风险与回滚:纯增量键,默认值不变,现有数据源零变化;引擎尚未读取(第二个 PR 才接上),回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/spec/src/data/datasource.zod.ts`(键、两个常量、内置驱动拒收)→ `packages/spec/liveness/datasource.json`(planned 行)→ `datasource.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/data/datasource.test.ts -t 29762`,预期 7 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `ExternalDatasourceSettingsSchema` declares `rowCap`: `z.number().int().min(1).max(EXTERNAL_ROW_CAP_CEILING).optional()`, beside `queryTimeoutMs`. No default is stamped onto a parsed block, so a served or round-tripped datasource is byte-identical to today's; absent means `EXTERNAL_ROW_CAP_DEFAULT`.
- Two constants exported from `@objectstack/spec/data`: `EXTERNAL_ROW_CAP_DEFAULT = 1000` (today's fixed value, which `@objectstack/objectql`'s `EXTERNAL_ROW_CAP` will read from in PR 2) and `EXTERNAL_ROW_CAP_CEILING = 10_000` (the ruled platform maximum).
- Refusals, each where the key would do nothing: on a built-in driver at `external.rowCap`, naming the driver (it runs the whole query itself and is never floored); on a managed datasource through the existing managed-block refusal, which lists `rowCap` among the keys to remove. Above the ceiling, zero, negative and fractional values are refused at parse. `maxRows` / `rowLimit` / `maxRowCount` fold onto `rowCap` in the suggestion.
- Liveness: `external.rowCap` graded `planned`, with the reader (`external-driver-floor.ts`) named and the flip to `live` owed by PR 2.
- Regenerated: `content/docs/references/data/datasource.mdx` (`gen:docs`) and `packages/spec/authorable-surface/data.json` (`gen:schema`). `authorable-surface.base.json` is not touched.

Precedent for the shape: `LoopConfigSchema.maxIterations` is bounded by `LOOP_MAX_ITERATIONS_CEILING` the same way (`packages/spec/src/automation/control-flow.zod.ts`). Name chosen: `rowCap`, the customer's own spelling and the `EXTERNAL_ROW_CAP*` family's.

## Tests

`packages/spec/src/data/datasource.test.ts`, describe `[#29762] external.rowCap`: the ruled numbers; accepted on a plugin driver from 1 to the ceiling in `external` and `validate-only`; no default stamped on parse; refused above the ceiling, at 0, -1 and 2500.5; the alias fold; refused on `sqlite` naming the driver; refused on a managed datasource through the managed-block refusal.

## Acceptance notes

- Measurement before building: issue comment 6595439927. Ruling: (a) + (c), ceiling 10,000; (b) stays with #27261; the 2,000-row renderer ceiling (objectui#7210 ruling a′) was not ruled on.
- The engine contract `EngineDatasourceDef.external` gains `rowCap` in PR 2, with the engine that reads it, so this PR adds no surface ahead of a reader beyond the authored key itself.
